source: Review round 2, R2D-6 (an instance that started while the store could not be read never became ready)
statement: Every document readiness waits for is read again after a failed first read, without a request: the platform document, the configured prewarm documents and those a host names later. An instance that started while the store could not be read becomes ready once it can; while the store cannot be read, it stays not ready. A configured document counts as loaded only once its own prewarm has completed, not another's.
guards: runtime:DocumentReadinessRetryTest#a host whose first reads failed becomes ready once the store answers, with no request
runtime:DocumentReadinessRetryTest#a host whose store cannot be read stays not ready
runtime:DocumentReadinessRetryTest#the configured documents wait for their own prewarm, not another
